$comment: Strings that are legitimately identical to the English source in a given locale. Each entry is a decision, written down: `<locale>|<key>|<text>`. scripts/i18n/v14-merge.mjs refuses any other value equal to the English source, so 'the translation matches the English' is never a silent pass. Review this file when it grows — a long list means a translator is copying, not translating.

cognates.vi|nav.menu|Menu: Vietnamese uses the French loanword 'menu' for a navigation menu.
cognates.id|nav.menu|Menu: Standard Indonesian; 'daftar' would mean a list of items, not a navigation menu.
